core_obligations: Forward direction (proof lines 1116-1120): induction on the formula A, declared 'easy' - the connective and quantifier clauses step the rank counter down against the game's round budget; stated as the first half with the mechanism named.
Converse, basis (lines 1121-1126): n = 0 peels quantifier-free agreement down to atomic agreement, giving I_0 directly.

Converse, step (lines 1127-1152): given agreement at rank n+1, for each a in M form the rank-n type T^a_n - finitely many formulas by the cited finiteness proposition, so conjoinable to one formula - then the existential witness sentence has rank n+1, transfers to N producing b with I_n(a-augmented, b-augmented); the mirror argument for b side completes the back-and-forth clause.
proof_roadmap: Games refine formulas: induct on syntax.
Formulas detect games: induct on rounds.
Compress the finite rank-n type into one existential and spend the shared rank n+1 sentence.

The cited finiteness proposition has a thin proof of its own (see prereq). H3: deep two-way argument with one declared-but-compressed half.
